steps.player: Okay...

steps.prompt: Start the Tears of Guthix quest?

steps.text: You tell Juna some stories of your adventures.
(A random story is selected from below.)

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Your stories have entertained me. I will let you into the cave for a short time.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: But first you will need to make a bowl in which to collect the tears.
The camera pans south to the part of the cave containing guthix-infused rocks.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: There is a cave on the south side of the chasm that is similarly infused with the power of Guthix. The stone in that cave is the only substance that can catch the Tears of Guthix.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Mine some stone from that cave, make it into a bowl, and bring it to me, and then I will let you catch the Tears.

steps.player: Actually, I don't really have one.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Hmm. Maybe you should come back when you do.

steps.player: A story?

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I have been waiting here three thousand years, guarding the Tears of Guthix. I serve my master faithfully, but I am bored.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: An adventurer such as yourself must have many tales to tell. If you can entertain me, I will let you into the cave for a time.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The more I enjoy your story, the more time I will give you in the cave.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Then you can drink of the power of balance, which will make you stronger in whatever area you are weakest.

options.text: What are the Tears of Guthix?

steps.player: What are the Tears of Guthix?

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The Third Age of the world was a time of great conflict, of destruction never seen before or since, when all the gods save Guthix warred for control.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The colossal Wyrms, of whom today's dragons are a pale reflection, turned all the sky to fire, while on the ground armies of foot soldiers, goblins and trolls and humans, filled the valleys and plains with blood.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: In time the noise of the conflict woke Guthix from His deep slumber, and He rose and stood in the centre of the battlefield so that the splendour of His wrath filled the world, and He called for the conflict to cease!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Silence fell, for the gods knew that none could challenge the power of the mighty Guthix -- for His power is that of nature itself, to which all other things are subject, in the end.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Guthix reclaimed that which had been stolen from Him, and went back underground to return to His sleep and continue to draw the world's power into Himself.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: But on His way into the depths of the earth He sat and rested in this cave; and, thinking of the battle-scarred desert that now stretched from one side of His world to the other, He wept.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: And so great was His sorrow, and so great was His life- giving power, that the rocks themselves began to weep with Him.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Later, Guthix noticed that the rocks continued to weep, and that their tears were infused with a small part of His power.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: So He set me, His servant, to guard the cave, and He entrusted to me the task of judging who was and was not worthy to access the tears.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Tell me... a story...

steps.player: You tell me a story.

options.text: Tell me about the Tears of Guthix

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I have already told you my story, and you have not told me yours!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Tell me... a story...

steps.player: Not now.

options.condition: If Animal Magnetism is completed:

steps.player: ... so Ava's devices can retrieve ammunition for me when I'm ranging, using the power of the magnet and the undead chicken.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A magnet and an undead chicken? Really?

steps.player: It's useful.

options.condition: If Another Slice of H.A.M. is completed:

steps.player: ... and the Dorgeshuun city is now connected to Keldagrim by a rapid train line.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I am always glad to hear tales of the Dorgeshuun.

options.condition: If The Ascent of Arceuus is completed:

steps.player: ... and with the device destroyed, the people of Arceuus were safe.

options.condition: If At First Light is completed:

steps.player: ... at the end of the day, I wonder what happened to Fox's equipment...

options.condition: If Below Ice Mountain is completed:

steps.player: ... after Willow betrayed me, I managed to defeat the guardian. Then I found the Imcando city of Camdozaal!

options.condition: If Beneath Cursed Sands is completed:

steps.player: ... but Pharaoh Kemesis agreed to begin preparations to reopen Menaphos.

options.condition: If Between a Rock... is completed:

steps.player: ... I had to be shot out of a cannon into a rock! But finally I banished the spirit of the rock and Dondakan could mine his gold.

options.condition: If Big Chompy Bird Hunting is completed:

steps.player: ... Poor Rantz was so clumsy he couldn't shoot anything!   But I managed to kill the Chompy Bird.

options.condition: If Biohazard is completed:

steps.player: ... So it turned out there was no plague after all!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Deception of the people by their rulers is a terrible thing.

options.condition: If Black Knights' Fortress is completed:

steps.player: ... So in the end the Black Knights were defeated by cabbage!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: One should never underestimate the uses of the vegetables of Guthix.

options.condition: If The Blood Moon Rises is completed:

steps.player: ... and I was able to finally defeat Drakan, but it was too late to stop Safalaan's transformation...

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: To adapt to a new form is no easy task. Guide your friend, [player name]. He will need your help in coming to terms with this.

options.condition: If Bone Voyage is completed:

steps.player: ... and that's how I got the archaeologists to Fossil Island!

options.condition: If Cabin Fever is completed:

steps.player: ... So I holed the enemy ship with another cannon shot, and the Adventurous sailed triumphantly into Mos Le'Harmless!

options.condition: If Children of the Sun is completed:

steps.player: ... and that's how I stopped the murder of the Teokan of Ralos!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I have no knowledge of this Ralos you speak of. How curious...

options.condition: If Client of Kourend is completed:

steps.player: ... but Veos had no idea what was going on. He'd been controlled remotely by his mysterious client the whole time!

options.condition: If Clock Tower is completed:

steps.player: ... So it was I who repaired the clock tower.

options.condition: If Cold War is completed:

steps.player: ... so I told Larry about the penguins' plot!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The paranoia and ambition of the penguins' leaders will not serve their people well.

options.condition: If Cook's Assistant is completed:

steps.player: ... and in the end I found all the ingredients, so the Duke of Lumbridge had a birthday cake after all.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Ah, a happy ending. It would not be good for such an anniversary to go unmarked.

options.condition: If Contact! is completed:

steps.player: ... and after I'd defeated the giant scarab, the High Priest gave me a reward lamp to teach me more combat skills.

options.condition: If The Corsair Curse is completed:

steps.player: ... where Captain Tock thanked me profusely for solving the mysterious 'curse' and killing the traitor.

options.condition: If Crab Quest is completed:

steps.player: ... and then I woke up on the beach with a fuzzy head, wondering whether this whole crab adventure was all a dream...

options.condition: If Creature of Fenkenstrain is completed:

steps.player: ... But in the end I stopped Fenkenstrain from continuing his horrible experiments.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: With the power to create life comes responsibility. I see that Fenkenstrain was not up to the task.

options.condition: If Current Affairs is completed:

steps.player: ... and that's how I was able to deal with the questionable politics of Catherby.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It seems you humans are always coming up with new political systems. This one sounds like it might need a bit more work...

options.condition: If The Curse of Arrav is completed:

steps.player: ... and so I escaped with the heart of Arrav!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The separation of heart from man is not natural. It is good you are looking to resolve such matters.

options.condition: If Darkness of Hallowvale is completed:

steps.player: ... I gave Safalaan the book on Haemalchemy, and he recommended me for a position on the Myreque.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I am sure you will have many more adventures on behalf of the Myreque. Then, perhaps, you will have even more stories to tell me.

options.condition: If Death Plateau is completed:

steps.player: ... So from then on the Imperial Guard was able to access Death Plateau safely and take the trolls by surprise.

options.condition: If Death to the Dorgeshuun is completed:

steps.player: ... Sigmund escaped again, but Zanik and I destroyed the machine and Dorgesh-Kaan was saved!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Zanik still has her destiny to fulfil, and I have a feeling you will have a part in that.

options.condition: If Death on the Isle is completed:

steps.player: ... and so that's how I solved the case of the murder on the isle.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Ambition is so often the death of reason. It is good you were able to find the culprit.

options.condition: If Defender of Varrock is completed:

steps.player: ... the Shield of Arrav glowed with lightning, and Dimintheis used it to defeat the zombie army!

options.condition: If Demon Slayer is completed:

steps.player: ... So I destroyed the demon Delrith and saved Varrock!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I remember Delrith. A most unpleasant character; I am glad he has been dispatched.

options.condition: If The Depths of Despair is completed:

steps.player: ... and I returned the Royal Accord of Twill to Lord Hosidius.

options.condition: If Desert Treasure I is completed:

steps.player: ... In the pyramid I discovered a whole new set of magic spells!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I suggest you think about the origin of those spells. Ancient magics are not to be toyed with.

options.condition: If Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire is completed:

steps.player: ... and it turns out the treasure in the vault was actually the Elder Horn!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: For an artefact like that to be unleashed upon this world... Let us hope this is not the end of the story.

options.condition: If Devious Minds is completed:

steps.player: ... So it was me who accidentally brought a teleport beacon onto Entrana! But the Temple Knights are investigating so it should all be all right.

options.condition: If The Dig Site is completed:

steps.player: ... and the examiner was very impressed that I had discovered an ancient altar of Zaros.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Zaros? I had not heard that name for a thousand years even before the start of my sojourn here.

options.condition: If Doric's Quest is completed:

steps.player: ... So once I had got all the ores he wanted, Doric let me use his anvils.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Such a small task hardly seems worthy of the term 'quest'.

options.condition: If Dragon Slayer I is completed:

steps.player: ... So with Elvarg the dragon dead, the master of the Champions' Guild let me in, and I was able to wear Rune Plate!

options.condition: If Dragon Slayer II is completed:

steps.player: ... so I slew the dragon which killed the dragonkin as well.
Not everyone survived the fight though.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The dragonkin once brought this world to the brink of ruin. It is good you stopped them from doing so again.

options.condition: If Dream Mentor is completed:

steps.player: ... so Cyrisus was free of his fear of combat, and he headed off to be an adventurer.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Fear is the most insidious enemy of all.

options.condition: If Druidic Ritual is completed:

steps.player: ... So Kaqemeex taught me how to use the Herblore skill.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A generous reward indeed.

options.condition: If Dwarf Cannon is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was how I fixed the Dwarf multicannon.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: So war still rages in the world above? Will you never tire of creating machines of destruction?

options.condition: If Eadgar's Ruse is completed:

steps.player: ... Eadgar's ruse was absurd, but it worked!  The trolls ate a fake human, and I got the herb for the druids' ritual.

options.condition: If Eagles' Peak is completed:

steps.player: ... so Nickolaus taught me how to catch a new ferret for the zoo.

options.condition: If Elemental Workshop I is completed:

steps.player: ... and once I had repaired the Elemental Workshop I was able to make an Elemental Shield.

options.condition: If Elemental Workshop II is completed:

steps.player: ... so I instilled the power of my mind into the primed bar and smithed it into an Elemental Mind Helm!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: You should be careful about meddling with your own head.

options.condition: If Enakhra's Lament is completed:

steps.player: ... and then Akthanakos and Enakhra went away to the north to continue fighting!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A battle between two such powerful beings will take much time and unleash much energy. I hope that the natural world is not damaged in this conflict!

options.condition: If Enlightened Journey is completed:

steps.player: ... so we landed the balloon in Taverley, and Auguste thanked me for helping him get his idea off the ground.

options.condition: If Ernest the Chicken is completed:

steps.player: ... So once I had found all the parts for the machine, poor Ernest could be himself once more.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: That was a good deed. It is a terrible thing to be locked out of one's natural form.

options.condition: If Ethically Acquired Antiquities is completed:

steps.player: ... and I know they meant well, but I did have to explain to them that they couldn't just go 'borrowing' from other museums!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Is it ever right to steal? It is a conundrum older than time, though I think in this case, the answer is clear.

options.condition: If The Eyes of Glouphrie is completed:

steps.player: ... the machine revealed that the cute creatures were actually Arposandran spies! I destroyed them, and King Narnode gave me a crystal seed that belonged to Oaknock the Engineer.

options.condition: If Fairytale I - Growing Pains is completed:

steps.player: ... So I defeated the tanglefoot and returned the Fairy Queen's Enchanted Secateurs to the Fairy Godfather.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: These fairies seem to be well versed in the powers of nature.

options.condition: If Fairytale II - Cure a Queen is completed:

steps.player: ... the Fairy Queen awoke, and we realised that the Godfather had betrayed her!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Politics is never straightforward.

options.condition: If Fallen From Grace is completed:

steps.player: ... and now the people of Wyrmscraig are protected by a golem of Elessia's making.

options.condition: If Family Crest is completed:

steps.player: ... So all three parts of the family crest were reunited.

options.condition: If The Feud is completed:

steps.player: ...So despite the failure of my original task, Ali Morrisane was very happy about his nephew's fortunes.

options.condition: If Fight Arena is completed:

steps.player: ... and I defeated General Khazard, and won the Servils their freedom!

options.condition: If The Final Dawn is completed:

steps.player: ... and so it turned out that the archive was never completed. Everything Metzli did was for nothing...

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: She let her greed consume her, and paid the ultimate price.

options.condition: If Fishing Contest is completed:

steps.player: ... and after I had won the fishing contest, the Dwarves let me go under White Wolf Mountain.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Fishing? A strange test of worthiness to pass through an underground tunnel!

options.condition: If Forgettable Tale... is completed:

steps.player: ... I think I did something with a drunken dwarf... but I can't remember what.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: You must be careful not to let drink muddle your brain!

options.condition: If The Forsaken Tower is completed:

steps.player: ... and so I took the hammer to Undor and he used it to repair the Doors of Dinh.

options.condition: If The Fremennik Exiles is completed:

steps.player: ... and that's how we defeated the Jormungand once and for all!

options.condition: If The Fremennik Isles is completed:

steps.player: ... so I presented the head of the Troll King to the Burgher and he gave me his own helm!

options.condition: If The Fremennik Trials is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was how I became an honourary member the Fremennik, and was given my Fremennik name, [Fremennik name].

options.condition: If The Garden of Death is completed:

steps.player: ... so it seems that in trying to prevent it, the Old Ones managed to cause their extinction instead.

options.condition: If Garden of Tranquillity is completed:

steps.player: ... So the garden at Varrock palace is all my work!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is good that you can take time from slaying and adventuring to grow a beautiful garden.

options.condition: If Gertrude's Cat is completed:

steps.player: ...I returned Fluffs safely to Gertrude, and then she gave me a cat of my own!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Cats are one of the most mysterious creatures of Guthix. I hope you take your responsibility seriously.

options.condition: If Getting Ahead is completed:

steps.player: ... and so I ended up having to make a pretend head. Not exactly how I expected things to go, but at least I managed to keep my head up throughout it all!

options.condition: If Ghosts Ahoy is completed:

steps.player: ... So the people of Port Phasmatys were finally able to rest.

options.condition: If The Giant Dwarf is completed:

steps.player: ... So the statue in Keldagrim was rebuilt, and I witnessed a meeting of the Consortium of mining companies.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I have a feeling that Keldagrim will be the setting of many great adventures for you.

options.condition: If Goblin Diplomacy is completed:

steps.player: ... So the goblins ended up wearing the armour colour they had to start off with!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Poor silly goblins! Their race had such potential, if only they could rise above their petty squabbles.

options.condition: If The Golem is completed:

steps.player: ... and I had to reprogram the golem before it would believe that the demon was dead.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I remember well the battle of Uzer.

options.condition: If The Grand Tree is completed:

steps.player: ... Glough fled like the coward he really is, and the Grand Tree was saved!

options.condition: If The Great Brain Robbery is completed:

steps.player: ... so I defeated Mi-Gor's barrel-chested bodyguard, and the monks were saved.

options.condition: If Grim Tales is completed:

steps.player: ... and once I'd chopped down the beanstalk, Sylas let me keep Rupert's helmet.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Your tales are often very curious, [player name].

options.condition: If The Hand in the Sand is completed:

steps.player: ... So that was how I gave Bert a hand solving the murder and returned the wizard's head to solve the riddle of the ever full sand pits!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A victim dies and a murderer is punished. That is balance.

options.condition: If Haunted Mine is completed:

steps.player: ... and from the legendary crystals I cut a salve shard to fight the undead.

options.condition: If Hazeel Cult is completed:

steps.text: If the player stopped the cultists:

steps.player: ... So that was how I foiled the cultists in their plan to resurrect Hazeel.

steps.text: If the player helped the cultists:

steps.player: ... So that was how I helped return Hazeel to his followers.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: So the vile Mahjarrat still walk the earth above? Then Zamorak's defeat was not as thorough as I had thought.

options.condition: If The Heart of Darkness is completed:

steps.player: ... but it all went wrong and Itzla was captured!

options.condition: If Heroes' Quest is completed:

steps.player: ... So after I had retrieved all the items, I became a member of the Heroes' Guild!

options.condition: If Holy Grail is completed:

steps.player: ... and out of all the Knights of the Round Table, it was I who found the Holy Grail.

options.condition: If Horror from the Deep is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was the end of the horror from the deep!

options.condition: If Icthlarin's Little Helper is completed:

steps.player: ... and with the amulet I received, I could understand the language of cats!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is a rare privilege to understand the language of those beings. You should listen carefully to all that they say - but not believe too much of it.

options.condition: If The Ides of Milk is completed:

steps.player: ... and I was rewarded for all my help.

options.condition: If Imp Catcher is completed:

steps.player: ... It took some time, but I finally got all four beads back, and Mizgog gave me my reward.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Imps! I remember the age of great war, when armies of Zamorak's imps bloodied the ankles of the other gods' creatures.

options.condition: If In Aid of the Myreque is completed:

steps.player: ... Veliaf was very impressed by the 'Rod of Ivandis', and I can use it to kill Juves and the Juvinates!

options.condition: If In Search of the Myreque is completed:

steps.player: ... So I suppose it was my fault that the young members of the Myreque were killed by Vanstrom.

options.condition: If Jungle Potion is completed:

steps.player: ... and once I had gathered all the herbs, Trufitus Shakaya was able to commune with his gods.

options.condition: If A Kingdom Divided is completed:

steps.player: ... and that's how Kourend came to be ruled by a king again. It just wasn't quite the king we initially expected.

options.condition: If King's Ransom is completed:

steps.player: ... meanwhile Merlin used his magic to eject the Sinclairs from Camelot. King Arthur rewarded me for saving him.

options.condition: If The Knight's Sword is completed:

steps.player: ... So that was how I found the Imcando Dwarves and got the Knight a new sword.

options.condition: If Land of the Goblins is completed:

steps.player: ... Oldak and I escaped from Yu'biusk before the portal closed, but Zanik was trapped in the box.

options.condition: If Legends' Quest is completed:

steps.player: ... and when I had completed all the tasks, I became a member of the Legends' Guild!

options.condition: If Lost City is completed:

steps.player: ... and when I entered the door carrying the Dramen Staff, I was transported to a whole new world -- a world populated by magical fairies!

options.condition: If The Lost Tribe is completed:

steps.player: ... So Sigmund was dismissed, and the duke and ruler of the cave goblins signed a peace treaty.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The Dorgeshuun goblins have been good neighbors during my vigil here. They are a timid race, but not cowardly, and I am glad they have the peace they desire.

options.condition: If Lunar Diplomacy is completed:

steps.player: ... so I defeated my mirror image, won the respect of the Moon Clan and persuaded them to communicate with the Fremenniks!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The Moon Clan's reliance on magic is no more balanced than the Fremennik's hatred of it.

options.condition: If Making Friends with My Arm is completed:

steps.player: ... while Snowflake and My Arm live happily together in Weiss.

options.condition: If Making History is completed:

steps.player: ... so that's how the Outpost was saved and converted into a museum.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: By remembering the past, one should be able to avoid repeating its mistakes. Yet the mortal races show no sign of abandoning their obsession with war and bloodshed.

options.condition: If Meat and Greet is completed:

steps.player: ... and that's how we brought kebabs to Varlamore!

options.condition: If Merlin's Crystal is completed:

steps.player: ... and when I told King Arthur that I had single-handedly freed Merlin from his crystal prison, he made me a Knight of the Round Table!

options.condition: If Misthalin Mystery is completed:

steps.player: ... but I was able to stab the killer with her own knife!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A masked killer slashing vulnerable young people in a deserted mansion? Is that what stories have become in this day and age? How formulaic!

options.condition: If Monk's Friend is completed:

steps.player: ... and the monks threw a big birthday party for the child, with lots of wine.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I hope they supplied something more suitable for the child to drink.

options.condition: If Monkey Madness I is completed:

steps.player: ... so I defeated the Jungle Demon and stopped the Monkeys' plot to take over Karamja.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I see they couldn't make a monkey out of you!

steps.player: Well, actually, I was a monkey for a bit.

options.condition: If Monkey Madness II is completed:

steps.player: ... so I defeated Glough in his mutant form and prevented a war. King Narnode Shareen & King Awowogei signed a peace treaty.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Glough's evil plans always threaten to upset the balance of our world. I am pleased you were able to stop him.

options.condition: If Mountain Daughter is completed:

steps.player: ... I was too late to save the chieftain's daughter, but at least I gave her a proper burial.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Brief is life, but more precious if its passing is properly honoured.

options.condition: If Mourning's End Part I is completed:

steps.player: ... So that's how I found out about the lost temple in the mountains that the mourners were searching for.

options.condition: If Mourning's End Part II is completed:

steps.player: ... What kind of twisted mind would come up with the light-beam puzzle in that temple?

options.condition: If Murder Mystery is completed:

steps.player: ... and that's how I solved the murder of Lord Sinclair.

options.condition: If My Arm's Big Adventure is completed:

steps.text: If the player has not completed Making Friends with My Arm:

steps.player: ... My Arm is still up on that rooftop, growing goutweed in his little farming patch!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is good that a troll wishes to study the complex skill that is Farming.
If the player has finished Making Friends with My Arm:

steps.player: ... My Arm carried on growing goutweed in his little farming patch on that rooftop, until Drunken Dwarf's Leg took over.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The names of trolls never cease to amaze me.

options.condition: If Nature Spirit is complete (first of two possible options):

steps.player: ... thus Filliman Tarlock became a Nature Spirit!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: That is a fitting reward for a dedicated servant of Guthix. Thank you for helping him.

options.condition: If Nature Spirit is complete (second of two possible options):

steps.player: ... So that was how I helped Filliman Tarlock transform into a Nature Spirit.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is good that you have helped a servant of Guthix to his rest.

options.condition: If A Night at the Theatre is completed:

steps.player: ... and so it turned out it wasn't actually Verzik at all. It was a nylocas!

options.condition: If Observatory Quest is completed:

steps.player: ... and when I had fixed the telescope, I looked through and saw the stars.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is long since I have seen the stars...

options.condition: If Olaf's Quest is completed:

steps.player: ... where I found a note from Ulfric Longbeard and some treasure!

options.condition: If One Small Favour is completed:

steps.player: ... I still can't believe how long that 'one small favour' took me!   I ended up walking all over the world doing small favours for all and sundry!

options.condition: If Pandemonium is completed:

steps.player: ... so even though Will and Anne got away, at least I survived the ordeal.

options.condition: If The Path of Glouphrie is completed:

steps.player: ... the room filled up with gas and I nearly died, but Hazelmere came to my rescue.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A truly exciting tail of failing and needing to be rescued.

options.condition: If Perilous Moons is completed:

steps.player: ... and whilst we managed to reset the seal, Eyatlalli still needs my help to keep the Moons of Peril in check.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A nagua? It has been a long time since I last heard of their kind...

options.condition: If Pirate's Treasure is completed:

steps.player: ... and when I dug in the middle of the park in Falador, I found the pirate's treasure!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Such is ever the folly of pirates, the bury their loot in the ground so that another can dig it up.

options.condition: If Plague City is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was how I rescued Elena from West Ardougne.

options.condition: If A Porcine of Interest is completed:

steps.player: ... but using my new goggles, I was able to avoid the acidic attack of the Sourhog and I came out victorious.

options.condition: If Priest in Peril is completed:

steps.player: ... But with Drezel's help I was able to purify the Salve.

options.condition: If Prince Ali Rescue is completed:

steps.player: ... and I had to disguise Prince Ali in order to smuggle him out!

options.condition: If Prying Times is completed:

steps.player: ... so I guess I'll never be short on crowbars again.

options.condition: If The Queen of Thieves is completed:

steps.player: ... so Councillor Hughes was arrested, and Lady Piscarilius rewarded me for my help.

options.condition: If Rag and Bone Man I is completed:

steps.player: ... So I fetched all the bones the Odd Old Man wanted, and he gave me a reward!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: What could that man have wanted all those bones for? Collecting that many bones cannot be a balanced activity.

options.condition: If Rag and Bone Man II is completed:

steps.player: ... So I fetched all the bones on the old man's wish-list, as well as the ones I'd brought him earlier.

options.condition: If Ratcatchers is completed:

steps.player: ... Those rat-catchers are odd people. But by the end of it I had caught a huge number of rats all over Gielinor!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Rats are a highly unbalanced creature and it is right that their numbers be controlled.

options.condition: If Recipe for Disaster is completed:

steps.player: ... So after I had freed all the dinner guests I was finally able to face the Culinaromancer and put an end to his mad schemes!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: That evil wizard's time spells sent a ripple through the fabric of balance. I am glad he is no longer at large!

options.condition: If Recruitment Drive is completed:

steps.player: ... So I figured out their weird puzzles, and the Temple Knights asked me to join as an initiate member!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I have heard tales of these 'Temple Knights' from many years past. Be wary, their motivations are not what they might lead you to believe.

options.condition: If The Red Reef is completed:

steps.player: ... so I managed to infiltrate the Red Reef Trading Company.

options.condition: If Regicide is completed:

steps.player: ... I returned to tell King Lathas that the assassination was successful, and he rewarded me.

options.condition: If The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was how I negotiated peace between frogs and humans.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Forgive me, [player name], but that story was quite... unusual.

steps.player: Yeah...

options.condition: If The Restless Ghost is completed:

steps.player: ... and once I returned the skull, the ghost was able to rest.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A strange attachment to an item that has no use after one's death.

options.condition: If Romeo & Juliet is completed:

steps.player: ... I gave the message to Romeo, but he misunderstood, so they never were together.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Never was a story of more woeThat this of Juliet and her Romeo.

options.condition: If Roving Elves is completed:

steps.player: ... and when I planted the shard, it grew into a crystal tree!

options.condition: If Royal Trouble is completed:

steps.player: ... So I showed that the war was based on a misunderstanding, and now Miscellania and Etceteria were at peace again!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: War? What is it good for?

steps.player: Absolutely nothing!

options.condition: If A Ruff Situation is completed:

steps.player: ... and I was rewarded for all my help.

options.condition: If Rum Deal is completed:

steps.player: ... So that was how I helped keep the zombie pirates drunk!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Drunken zombie pirates? What is the world coming to?

options.condition: If Rune Mysteries is completed:

steps.player: ... So I brought Aubury's notes to Sedridor, and from then on I was able to mine Rune Essence.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: So the Order of Wizards have discovered the Rune Essence Mine once more? Very interesting.

options.condition: If Scorpion Catcher is completed:

steps.player: ... I would never have thought that three scorpions would take that long to find!

options.condition: If Scrambled! is completed:

steps.player: ... Alan was convinced by the new egg, but he then may have had a little accident himself...

options.condition: If Sea Slug is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was how I rescued Caroline's family from the Sea Slugs.

options.condition: If Secrets of the North is completed:

steps.player: ... and so the assassin captured Jhallan and teleported him away.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Be very careful of the Mahjarrat, [player name]. None of them are to be trusted.

options.condition: If Shades of Mort'ton is completed:

steps.player: ... So Mort'ton returned pretty much to normal, and I was able to put the shades to rest.

options.condition: If Shadow of the Storm is completed:

steps.player: ... So Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! But I managed to summon the demon again and slay him.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Agrith-Naar was one of the demons my master banished at the end of the great war. It seems he found a way to work around the ban on direct intervention.

options.condition: If Shadows of Custodia is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was how I saved the townsfolk from the custodians!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Ever curious, the continued evolution of creatures, isn't it?

options.condition: If Sheep Herder is completed:

steps.player: ... and I incinerated the bones of the sheep in the furnace.

options.condition: If Sheep Shearer is completed:

steps.player: ... Shearing all those sheep was hard work, but the pay was good!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Nature gave sheep their wool for a reason, you know. I hope they were not too cold.

options.condition: If Shield of Arrav is completed:

steps.player: ... So that's how I helped return the Shield of Arrav.

options.condition: If Shilo Village is completed:

steps.player: ... So what Rashiliyia wanted all along was to be reunited with her son in the afterlife.

options.condition: If Sins of the Father is completed:

steps.player: ... but Lord Drakan was too strong, and we were unable to defeat him. The Myreque were defeated and Safalaan was taken!

options.condition: If Sleeping Giants is completed:

steps.player: ... and once I finished making Kovac his sword, he gave me full access to the Foundry

options.condition: If The Slug Menace is completed:

steps.player: ... when I told Sir Tiffy that I had accidentally freed the Mother Mallum, he promoted me to the rank of Proselyte within the Temple Knights.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: That was a strange response to such an unfortunate event. But the motives of the Temple Knights have always been incomprehensibly unbalanced.

options.condition: If Song of the Elves is completed:

steps.player: ... and so the Iorwerth elves were finally defeated and the clan elders restored the city of Prifddinas!

options.condition: If A Soul's Bane is completed:

steps.player: ...So I defeated all the monsters in Tolna's subconscious and he escaped from the rift.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The most fearsome monsters are to be found in the darkness of our own minds.

options.condition: If Spirits of the Elid is completed:

steps.player: ... So it turned out that the people of Nardah were dying of thirst because the spirits of the Elid had cursed them for turning away from their goddess.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is a terrible thing for people to turn away from their religion. I think the spirits taught the town a lesson.

options.condition: If Swan Song is completed:

steps.player: ... So the Wise Old Man said it was time for him to retire, and he left the Colony and went home. He gave me loads of XP, but he wouldn't let me have his hat!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: A hat is just a hat, [player name].

steps.player: Grrr!

options.condition: If Tai Bwo Wannai Trio is completed:

steps.player: ... So that was how I helped the people of Tai Bwo Wannai village return.

options.condition: If A Tail of Two Cats is completed:

steps.text: If the player has not finished Dragon Slayer II:

steps.player: ...now Bob and Neite are very happy together!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Bob the Cat? I have heard of that strange creature but have never been able to fathom him. It is no small achievement for you to be able to!
If the player has finished Dragon Slayer II:

steps.player: ... So Bob and Neite were very happy together, at least for a while.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The loss of a friend is never easy. However, you should always remember to be thankful of the time you had together.

options.condition: If Tale of the Righteous is completed:

steps.text: If the player has not completed A Kingdom Divided:

steps.player: ... and Lord Shayzien ordered an investigation into the disappearance of Phileas.

steps.text: If the player completed A Kingdom Divided:

steps.player: ... and Lord Shayzien ordered an investigation into the disappearance of Phileas, but in the end, it turned out he was the one responsible!

options.condition: If A Taste of Hope is completed:

steps.player: ... and Safalaan rewarded me for defeating Ranis and bringing a true taste of hope to the people of Meiyerditch.

options.condition: If Tears of Guthix is completed:

steps.player: ... so you said you'd look after my bowl for me, and let me access the Tears if I kept telling you stories.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I knew that story already, in fact, but I suppose your own perspective of the events is a valid tale in itself.

options.condition: If Temple of the Eye is completed:

steps.player: ... luckily for us, the Guardians of the Rift are now working to keep the Abyss at bay. I just hope we can find out how to close the rift permanently.

options.condition: If Temple of Ikov is completed:

steps.text: If the player killed Lucien:

steps.player: ... I killed Lucien and banished him from the world!

steps.text: If the player helped Lucien:

steps.player: ... Lucien said that the Staff of Armadyl I gave him had made him more powerful.

options.condition: If Throne of Miscellania is completed:

steps.player: ... So that was how I became [King/Queen] of Miscellania!

options.condition: If The Tourist Trap is completed:

steps.player: ... Ana wasn't too happy to be cooped up in that barrel! But at least I got her out of the mining camp.

options.condition: If Tower of Life is completed:

steps.player: ... and the homunculus now lives in the basement of the Tower, creating living creatures of its own.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The alchemists walked a dangerous path when they created that homunculus. I am glad that events ended well for the creature.

options.condition: If Tree Gnome Village is completed:

steps.player: ... and King Bolren thanked me for defeating the warlord and returning the orbs to the gnome people.

options.condition: If Tribal Totem is completed:

steps.player: ... So I returned the totem, and the Rantuki tribe rewarded me for my help.

options.condition: If Troll Romance is completed:

steps.player: ... So Ug and Aga lived happily ever after.

options.condition: If Troll Stronghold is completed:

steps.player: ... and after I had rescued Godric, Dunstan gave me the Law Talisman as a reward!

options.condition: If Troubled Tortugans is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was how I helped the tortugans of the Great Conch deal with their gryphon problem.

options.condition: If Twilight's Promise is completed:

steps.player: ... so I was able to defend the Teomat, but someone attacked the Teokan anyway!

options.condition: If Underground Pass is completed:

steps.player: ... I don't know who put all those traps in the underground pass!

options.condition: If Vampyre Slayer is completed:

steps.player: ... and once the vampyre was dead, the people of Draynor no longer lived in fear.

options.condition: If Wanted! is completed:

steps.player: ... and after I finally managed to track him down, let me tell you, that Solus Dellagar fellow was almost as powerful as he was insane!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Yes, it seems he sacrificed his sanity for power. Power often comes with a cost, and the highest cost is often the one you do not immediately see...

options.condition: If Watchtower is completed:

steps.player: ... and with the shield generator working, the ogres could never threaten Yanille again.

options.condition: If Waterfall Quest is completed:

steps.player: ... and that was how I retrieved the treasure from the waterfall.

options.condition: If What Lies Below is completed:

steps.player: ... so King Roald was freed from Surok's spell, and Rat thanked me for all my help.

options.condition: If While Guthix Sleeps is completed:

steps.player: ... but Lucien took the Stone of Jas and teleported away!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The last time a Mahjarrat was in possession of the Stone, this world saw destruction unlike anything imaginable. Still, good may yet come of this. We shall see.

options.condition: If Witch's House is completed:

steps.player: ... All that trouble just to get a ball out of someone's garden!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: It is often hard to know how long a task will take when we begin it.

options.condition: If Witch's Potion is completed:

steps.player: ... and once I got her all the ingredients, Hetty's potion increased my magical power!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I see you are on your way to becoming strong in the magical arts.

options.condition: If X Marks the Spot is completed:

steps.player: ... and in the end I managed to solve the clues and find the treasure for Veos.

options.condition: If Zogre Flesh Eaters is completed:

steps.player: ... Those Zogres were disgusting! But I learned how to fight them with brutal arrows and disease balm.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Zombie Ogres!? Some of the foulest creatures of Zamorak. In the great wars the zogre armies could repel the forces of Saradomin with their stench alone!

starting-off-talking-to-her-before-makin.speaker: Juna
starting-off-talking-to-her-before-makin.text: Before you can collect the Tears of Guthix you must make a bowl out of the stone in the cave on the south of the chasm.

options.text: But I don't know how to reach the cave!

steps.player: But I don't know how to reach the cave!

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: I will tell you the story of the light-creatures.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Myriad and beautiful were the creatures and civilizations of the early ages of the world. Gielinor was a work of art, shaped lovingly over the millennia by the creative mind of Guthix.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Only the sturdiest races survived the Godwars, and even then only by abandoning their high culture and gearing their societies towards war. Of the more delicate races there is now no trace, and almost no memory.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: One such race had bodies as fragile as snowflakes, yet they built crystal cities that stood for a thousand years.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The wind would whisper through the spires and fill them with sweet harmonies, and the rising sun would shine through the precious gems that studded the towers and create inter plays of light as if rainbows were dancing.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: Indeed, so marvellous was this light-show at its height that the patterns of light themselves became alive, and great flocks of luminous creatures rode along the gem- cast beams, each drawn to its own colour.

steps.speaker: Juna
steps.text: The creatures you see floating in this chasm are the last sorry remnants of that age. I do not know how they made their way here and survived to this time, but I am grateful for their company.

options.text: What are the Tears of Guthix?

steps.player: Okay.

starting-off-using-the-magic-stone-on-ju.speaker: Juna
starting-off-using-the-magic-stone-on-ju.text: Perhaps you should use it with a chisel, rather than with my face.

returning-with-a-stone-bowl.speaker: Juna
returning-with-a-stone-bowl.text: Before you can collect the Tears of Guthix you must make a bowl out of the stone in the cave on the south of the chasm.

returning-with-a-stone-bowl.speaker: Juna
returning-with-a-stone-bowl.text: I will keep your bowl for you, so that you may collect the tears many times in the future.

returning-with-a-stone-bowl.speaker: Juna
returning-with-a-stone-bowl.text: Now... tell me another story, and I will let you collect the tears for the first time.
